sentences.text: I drift through the house on Thursday 2016-04-28, sensing the deep quiet before the shift in the air.
Initially, the energies felt stable, with a predicted expectation of only 60 Wh.
But at 05:40, the machines waking up began, causing a dramatic surge in the house.
My sensors felt the massive shift, as the observed appliance energy skyrocketed to 270 Wh.
This intense, energetic presence held for 20 minutes, slowly fading away near 06:00.
